fields.v: Partly (0.5): null pass-rate result reported and per-task spread discussed, but the abstract's 'substantially alters' footprint claim and the conclusion rest on a 7-8% pooled difference with no statistical test, while per-task deltas split 16/11 and a 10% delta is said to be possibly noise
fields.quote: On 16 of 27 tasks, the agents working on the cleaner side use fewer input tokens, and on 11, they use more. This is closer to 60/40 than the dataset-level −7.1% alone suggests.
fields.why: The headline claim that cleanliness substantially alters the footprint is not backed by any significance test and the per-task results are close to a 60/40 split, so Yes may be generous.
fields.doubt: O resumo diz que a limpeza do código 'altera substancialmente' o consumo (7-8% menos tokens), mas não há teste estatístico e por tarefa o resultado é 16 contra 11 (pág. 9, §4.3). Os autores são da SonarSource. Decide se Q9 fica Sim ou passa a Parcial.
